stories.headline: Bitcoin recovers near $86,000 as falling oil supports risk appetite
stories.blurb: WTI slipped below $90 on Hormuz de-escalation talk; Monday’s ~$1B spot ETF haul still frames demand.

stories.headline: US spot Bitcoin ETFs draw ~$999M as BTC briefly tops $87K
stories.blurb: Largest daily BTC ETF inflow of 2026; IBIT led, while Ether ETFs added ~$270M the same session.

stories.headline: Binance buys $100M Circle stake in five-year USDC promotion deal
stories.blurb: Private placement closed Sept 17; Circle will pay monthly incentives tied to USDC held via its wallet infra.

stories.headline: Bitcoin clears its 50-week average for the first time in 45 weeks
stories.blurb: Galaxy flagged the weekly reclaim as a historic signal that the bear phase may have ended if price holds.

stories.headline: ZetaChain votes to shut its L1 and migrate ZETA to Solana
stories.blurb: Proposal 68 passed ~99.4%; a second vote is still required before migration and L1 wind-down.
